EEI Corp Appoints New Chief Operations Officer Amid Industry Growth

EEI Corp, a leading player in the Philippines’ engineering and construction sector, announced the appointment of Roberto S. Ilagan as its new Chief Operations Officer, effective immediately. The company said Ilagan will oversee operations across all domestic and international projects, reflecting EEI Corp’s commitment to operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Ilagan, who brings over 25 years of experience in large-scale infrastructure projects, was previously the managing director of Atlas Infrastructure Solutions. In a statement, EEI Corp President and CEO Maria Teresa Santos said, “Roberto’s proven leadership and extensive background in project execution will be invaluable as we continue to expand our footprint in both local and overseas markets.” Santos added that Ilagan’s expertise aligns with EEI Corp’s strategic priorities in digital transformation and project efficiency.

The appointment comes as the Philippine construction industry is forecast to grow by 7.6% this year, according to the Philippine Contractors Association. EEI Corp, which posted revenues of PHP 21.8 billion in 2023, has a strong order book of infrastructure, energy, and industrial projects both in the country and abroad.

Ilagan commented, “It is an honor to join EEI Corp at such a dynamic time. I look forward to working with our talented teams to deliver high-quality projects that meet the evolving needs of our clients and communities.”

Industry analysts welcomed the move, citing Ilagan’s reputation for driving operational improvements. “His appointment signals EEI Corp’s intent to strengthen its project delivery capabilities,” said Rafael Cruz, an analyst at Manila Equity Research.

No other major changes to EEI Corp’s leadership structure were announced.
